analyze_train_time: analyze training time from json logs to find slowest and fastest epochs
plot_training_curve: plot training metric curves from json logs for specified metrics like bbox_mAP
load_json_logs: load and convert json log files into epoch-keyed dictionaries for analysis
parse_cli_args: parse command line arguments for plot_curve and cal_train_time subcommands
save_plot_to_file: save plotted metric curves to an output file path instead of displaying
